# Truejoin

> Truejoin is an open-source (Apache 2.0) data gateway that serves corporate relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle) to AI agents and LLMs over MCP, a REST/OpenAPI API and analytical SQL on DuckDB. A language model drafts a data catalog that a person approves; every query then runs under the caller's row-level security rules and column masks and leaves one audit event. It runs on-premises as one Python process, air-gapped if need be.

Key facts:

- Interfaces: MCP (streamable HTTP at /mcp, or stdio), REST per table (/api/v1/{database}/{table}), analytical SQL and tools (/olap), web console (/ui, English and Turkish).
- 18 MCP tools: list_sources, describe_table, query_data, search_data, aggregate_data, create_view, list_views, refresh_view, load_table, list_metrics, query_metrics, cache_stats, check_readiness, find_examples, search_terms, get_term, check_question, answer_question. The default analyst profile leaves out create_view, refresh_view and cache_stats.
- answer_question reads a question in words against the approved business vocabulary with no model at query time, and returns the request it understood and the compiled SQL. A question the vocabulary cannot read is answered with SQL a model writes (olap.unread_questions: sql, the default) or refused.
- Governance: row rules and masks are applied by rewriting each query, so joins, aliases, subqueries and CTEs cannot read around them, including SQL a model wrote. Production mode refuses unsafe configuration at startup.
- Sign-in: API keys, OpenID Connect, LDAP (Active Directory, OpenLDAP, FreeIPA, lldap) and local users managed in the console.
- Model providers: Ollama (local), OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini. Samples are masked, and go to a cloud model only when analysis.share_samples_with_cloud_llm is on.
- Not a data warehouse, ETL tool or BI dashboard: it reads existing databases. REST reads them live; the analytical side (OLAP, MCP) answers from what it loaded, reloaded every olap.refresh_interval seconds when set (off by default).
- Status: 1.0.0 in development, installed from source with uv; not on PyPI.
- Documentation site: https://yaman.dev/truejoin/ (this file is at https://yaman.dev/truejoin/llms.txt).
